notes.title: SECOND DLC: LIGHT
notes.content:
The second DLC: Light is ready. True, I took my time, but I believe, that it will bring more fun to you, the players. The video game went through a sample development from DARKNESS, through WISH to LIGHT. It's like the personal development of a man, who decided to step into the unknown, into the darkness, relying solely and only on himself, on his consciousness, which brought him to life amazing knowledge, experiences and especially people, thanks to which the video game Dark Blocks is more beautiful partly. Thank you Víťo, Honzo, Kamile, Barborko.

The second DLC: Light contains 36 levels for 3 poems. Of course it brings new bonuses, blocks and a different style of tapping in the game. The video game contains a total of 96 levels, wow, that's not what I originally intended.

By releasing the last DLC for Dark Blocks, I made another important milestone in my life. The second game of the Dark Beast is completely finished. Now I want to return to the first Dark Asteroids and improve it with a few details. I believe that the game will be more pleasant and that you, the players, will enjoy it even more. Then I can jump on another game project.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38931417/b4e567817d147638fa4a117456f91b81b47f7e52.jpg[/img]

notes.title: FIRST DLC: WISH
notes.content:
The first DLC is done. It was incredibly fun to design new Blocks, Bonuses and Levels. I felt like a tree, that had just blossomed in a stream of new sap. Yes, it has already happened to me, in the winter, and I believe, that the new energy will not just flow away.

It is important to be able to achieve your dreams. But even more important is to be able to enjoy the daily steps. That's the real luck and I try to share that in my game, and to learn a bit. Enjoy DLC as much as I do its development and believe me - we don't have to look for happiness, just be happy.

The second DLC, Light, for Dark Block, will be different from what the game offers now. Yes, Bat and Ball will still be, but the Blocks will change somehow. Keep your fingers crossed for me, I'm going to make new Bonuses, Blocks and 36 levels for 3 poems.

Now my thoughts stick back to the first game of Dark Asteroids and improve it with new ideas. I believe that the game will be more pleasant and that you, the players, will enjoy it even more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38931417/61780fd5c2ab0d0f20692e218db3892ccc5fe8a7.jpg[/img]

notes.title: JUKEBOX UPDATE
notes.content:
I have amazing news for you. I decided to add two FREE extensions to the base game. Each DLC will have 24 new levels and three poems. So a total of six new poems in 48 levels. I will also add new types of blocks and bonuses. Look forward to it.

[b]You can already in JUKEBOX listen to new songs for both extensions. In JUKEBOX you can also play your favorite song indefinitely, or choose to play all twelve songs sequentially.[/b]

The game has undergone other changes.

The ball, repeatedly bouncing off the left and right sides of the screen is nuisance. Watch how it reflects at length and not be able to intervene in any way, is bore. Now, when this situation occurs, the ball is after 6 bounces charged (countdown) and aimed directly at the player's bat. Amazing. :-)

The second change is when clearing all blocks in the level. The ball now moves smoothly to the bat and sticks. This leads to the thought of not making it a new bonus. ;-)

The game can now be tried for free in the DEMO available on Steam.

I'm planning for Christmas to give DLC: WISHES. After the new year comes the second DLC: LIGHT. I plan to improve the game even then. So far, more than enough new tasks have been set. Wish me luck. Dark Beast 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38931417/7cf724a47e3f9a46e705a95af42de22ac4d16b0f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: DEMO RELEASE
notes.content:
Years ago, it was customary for most games to release DEMO, so that the player could try it. As a player, I have always welcomed this possibility, and therefore I logically offer it in my game projects as well.

DEMO is now available on the store page. Please enjoy the game as much as I develop it. Have fun.
